sn22.29:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || Yo bhikkhave rūpam abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati || yo dukkham abhinandati aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || Yo vedanam abhinandati || || Yo saññam abhinandati || || Yo saṅkhāre abhinandati || || Yo viññāṇam abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati || yo dukkham abhinandati aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || Yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpam nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati parimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || Yo vedanaṃ nābhinandati || pe || Yo saññaṃ nābhinandati || || Yo saṅkhāre nābhinandati || || Yo viññāṇaṃ nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati || yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmīti || || Sāvatthi || ||
